 By BVM Sportsdesk, 23h ago No. 1 South Carolina heads to Providence on Saturday for the first of two New England games, looking to build on a 4-0 start powered by efficient scoring, strong rebounding and contributions across the roster. The Gamecocks tip off at 1:30 p.m. ET; the game streams on Peacock.
 By the Numbers South Carolina averages 91.0 points per game and shoots 49.3% from the field.
 The Gamecocks have a +12.8 rebounding margin and rank among the nation’s leaders in offensive rebounding.
 Tessa Johnson is shooting 52.0% from 3-point range; Joyce Edwards averages 17.2 points per game.
 South Carolina beat Providence 96-55 in the teams’ first meeting, in December 2025.
 Yes, But South Carolina’s offense runs without a traditional point guard, using a shared playmaking approach led by guards and forwards alike. The results so far have been efficient, but the team faces a demanding early schedule, including three games against ranked opponents in its first four outings.
 What’s Next South Carolina opens its New England road swing at Providence on Saturday, then continues with a second game on the trip. A win would extend its strong start and add another road test against a team it beat handily last season.
 Bottom Line The Gamecocks’ depth, rebounding and shared offensive creation are fueling their early success; the Providence matchup is the next test of whether those strengths travel.
